card.name: Start of chelate and anticoagulant words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word such as chelate, chondrolysis or anticoagulant, mostly in drug interaction text. It fires on "ch" before "elate" or "ondrolysis", and on "ulant" in "anticoagulant".
